findings.summary: Changing the type assertion in AssertExpectationsForObjects from Mock to *Mock means a Mock value no longer matches and falls through to the assertExpectationser assertion, which panics because AssertExpectations has a pointer receiver.
A *Mock (e.g. &myMock.Mock), the correct call style, now hits the branch that logs the 'Deprecated…' warning, so the warning is wrong for pointers.
Making the mutex a non-pointer sync.Mutex means any code or test that copies a Mock by value (including a restored value case) triggers go vet copylocks warnings.
